data.current_description:
The main endpoint. Pass `updated_after` to receive only what has changed since
your last sync, including orders whose COGS, fulfilment cost or attribution were
corrected after they were placed.

Results are ordered oldest-change-first, so the `updated_at` of the last record
you successfully processed is always a safe watermark to resume from.
data.description_suggestion: Retrieve orders with their economic details (revenue, COGS, fulfillment costs, attribution, margins). Pass `updated_after` to sync only changed orders since your last call, including corrections to COGS, fulfillment costs, or attribution. Results are ordered oldest-change-first by `updated_at`, making the last processed record's timestamp a safe resumption point for incremental syncs. Supports pagination and filtering by date range and product.
